# Brev

> Modern, open-source mail client for macOS and iOS. Standalone app with
> Brev-owned mail, UI, and provider layers. Native on each platform,
> IDE-style theming, zero telemetry. By Henrik Ø. Gaard.

## Reading order for LLMs

Read in this order before designing anything:

1. AGENTS.md — the contract for AI agents in this repo
2. ADRs/README.md — the index of architectural decisions
3. ADRs/0028-mail-provider-architecture.md — the north star
4. ADRs/0001 through 0012 — the foundational decisions

## Repository map

- ADRs/ — architecture decisions (canonical for design)
- prompts/ — agent prompt templates for common tasks
- packages/ — Swift packages (BrevBackend, BrevMail, BrevDesign,
  BrevThemes, BrevAvatars, BrevCalendar, BrevAI, BrevGmail,
  BrevSyncEngine)
- apps/ — macOS and iOS app targets
- themes/ — JSON theme files
- docs/ — human-facing documentation

## Hard rules (mechanically enforced)

- No literal Color values in views. Use theme tokens.
- No Matomo, Sentry, or other telemetry libraries.
- Views never see Realm types.
- Capability-driven UI, not backend type-checks.
- ADR required for protected-path changes (see ADRs/0005).

## Status

Pre-alpha. The current repo supports generic IMAP/SMTP and a native Gmail
adapter. Microsoft Graph/Exchange is future provider scope.
